title: Origin story: Pandora
description: Pandora was fashioned by Hephaestus from earth and water at Zeus's command, as punishment for Prometheus's theft of fire. Each god gave her a gift — beauty, cunning, a deceitful nature — and Zeus gave her a sealed jar, warning her never to open it. Her curiosity overcame her, and she loosed every evil into the world, slamming the lid in time to trap only Hope inside.

title: Ability profile: Pandora
description: Ranked abilities: Curiosity — rank 100/100; Charm — rank 93/100; Adaptability — rank 91/100; Resilience — rank 90/100; Persuasion — rank 88/100.

title: Power ranking: Pandora
description: Powers: Gifts of every Olympian combined in one being; The jar's seal — and its breaking; Hope itself, kept safe within.

title: Stamina feats: Pandora
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Bore the blame of all the world's evils without being destroyed by it; Endured as the first mother of a suffering race.

title: Crossover notes: Pandora
description: Pandora crosses naturally with: curiosity, gifts, unintended consequence.

title: Cultural impact: Pandora
description: Pandora's box is the universal image of unleashed consequence.

title: Generator record: Pandora
